value.rationale: This naturally motivated intervention problem asks for every minimum set of permanently fixed opinions ensuring deterministic robust agreement on the vertex-transitive Franklin network. The exact 144 labelled placements, six symmetry classes, different independent-versus-one-edge seed structures and two sharp times are neither supplied by general duality nor by a bare minimum-cardinality calculation. It resolves a complete finite optimal placement and delay census rather than a handpicked small example; the entire computation has standalone reproducibility.
